articles.headline: Bukayo Saka starts for England vs Panama, Declan Rice rested - sources
articles.description: Bukayo Saka is set to start for England in their final World Cup group game against Panama on Saturday, while Declan Rice has been rested, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Why every round-of-32 team will, won't win FIFA World Cup
articles.description: Then there were 32. Or we're getting there, anyway. So, let's review why each team still alive at the 2026 World Cup could win the whole thing -- and why each probably won't.

articles.headline: Manchester City monitoring Morocco midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi
articles.description: Manchester City are monitoring Morocco midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi ahead of a possible move this summer, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily LIVE: Cristiano Ronaldo's new golden boots, Argentina rest Messi as final groups decided
